name: Heat flow
statement: Heat flows from hot to cold.

name: Heat engines
statement: Heat engines turn a heat flow into work.

name: Entropy
statement: Entropy measures how spread out energy is.

name: Heat direction
statement: Thermal energy moves from warmer to cooler bodies.

name: Engines
statement: Heat engines turn a heat flow into work.

name: Second law
statement: Entropy of an isolated system never decreases.

name: Carnot limit
statement: No engine can beat the Carnot efficiency.

name: Carnot efficiency
statement: Carnot efficiency depends only on the two reservoir temperatures.

name: Cold reservoir
statement: A heat engine must reject heat to a cold reservoir.
